summary.result: Overall, this study is meaningful in that the results could be foundations as to strengthen risk management capacity for agricultural engineering projects.
summary.background: The accident risk at the construction workplace associated with agricultural engineering is comparatively higher than those of other fields due mainly to its complex work types and processes.
summary.method: The characteristics that most agricultural projects have conducted on a small-scale even worsen the situation drawing low attentions to risk management.
